security_audit.summary: The 20 external-command findings are false positives caused by Markdown inline code and code fences. The documented BulkPublish URL is an expected destination for the multipart API flow. The skill can transmit local files in bulk without an explicit confirmation safeguard, which remains a medium-risk data-handling concern.

remediation.issue: Local paths can be uploaded in bulk without an explicit review step.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation that lists each local file before any upload, especially when multiple files are selected.

remediation.issue: The multipart flow requires a bearer API key.
remediation.suggestion: Tell users to provide credentials through the approved secret mechanism and never place keys in prompts, logs, or published content.

remediation.issue: Uploads may use a public URL.
remediation.suggestion: Confirm the URL and its ownership with the user before upload, and do not fetch private-network or credential-bearing URLs.

content.user_title: Publish media and posts in bulk
content.value_statement: Managing many media files and posts can take time and create mistakes. This skill organizes uploads and supports BulkPublish workflows for repeatable batch publishing.
actual_capabilities: Upload a media file from an approved local path or public URL.
Describe supported image and video formats and size limits.
Browse, inspect, and remove media items with BulkPublish media tools.
Explain multipart uploads for videos larger than 100 MB.
Collect media IDs for posts that use multiple files.
Explain bulk retry, reschedule, delete, and approval behavior.
limitations: It only documents BulkPublish workflows and does not publish to other services directly.
It does not replace required BulkPublish credentials or account permissions.
Multipart uploads require direct REST API access because no MCP tool is available.
It cannot approve posts on behalf of a required teammate.

use_cases.title: Prepare a campaign asset library
use_cases.description: Upload approved campaign images and videos, then collect media IDs for planned posts.

use_cases.title: Coordinate team approval
use_cases.description: Understand when bulk actions require approval and why pending posts are not scheduled.

use_cases.title: Handle a large video upload
use_cases.description: Follow the documented multipart sequence for an approved video larger than 100 MB.

prompt_templates.title: Upload one approved image
prompt_templates.prompt: Upload the approved local image at [file path] to BulkPublish. Confirm the file name and destination before uploading.

prompt_templates.title: Review supported media
prompt_templates.prompt: List the supported image and video formats for BulkPublish. Include the standard upload size limits.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare several assets
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these approved files: [file paths]. List them first, then upload each file only after I confirm the full list. Return the media IDs.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a large-video upload
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain the safe multipart upload steps for this approved video: [file path]. Do not expose my API key. Ask for confirmation before every network action.

output_examples.input: Review my approved campaign files before upload.
output: A numbered list of the selected file paths.
A request for confirmation before the upload begins.
Media IDs and file details after successful uploads.

output_examples.input: What happens when a bulk retry needs approval?
output_examples.output: Posts without publish permission return an approval-required response. Submit the posts for approval before a teammate approves them.

output_examples.input: How do I upload a 500 MB video?
output: Create the multipart upload with the exact file size.
Upload each ordered 10 MB part and retain its ETag.
Complete the upload using the part numbers and ETags.

best_practices: Confirm every local file and public URL before starting an upload.
Use the approved secret mechanism for BulkPublish API credentials.
Verify returned media IDs before attaching them to a post.
anti_patterns: Do not upload an unreviewed directory or a broad file-path pattern.
Do not paste bearer API keys into prompts, source files, or post content.
Do not retry or reschedule posts that still require approval.

faq.question: Can I upload from a local file path?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide one approved absolute local file path and confirm it before upload.

faq.question: Can I provide both a URL and a file path?
faq.answer: No. Provide either a public URL or a local file path for each upload.

faq.question: Which media formats are supported?
faq.answer: JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, MP4, MOV, and WebM are documented as supported formats.

faq.question: How large can a normal upload be?
faq.answer: Normal image and video uploads support files up to 100 MB.

faq.question: How do I upload a video larger than 100 MB?
faq.answer: Use the documented multipart REST API flow for eligible videos up to 1 GB.

faq.question: Why did a bulk retry require approval?
faq.answer: A role without publish permission must submit the posts for team approval before publishing.
